paite: Tu in milimte kiang a kithoihna tungtang zaw; i vek un theihna i nei chiat uh, chih i kithei hi. Theihna in mi akisatheisak a itna in mi abawlhoih hi.
heading: Kithoihna Sa Nek Thu A Dotna

paite: Kuapeuh in thil banghiam thei a akingaihtuahleh, atheih ding thei nai lou ahi.
Himahleh mi kuapeuh in Pathian a-itleh, huai mi mah ama theih ahi.
Huchi in milimte kiang a kithoihna thil nek thu zaw, "Khovel ah milim himhim bangmah ahihlouhdan uleh, khat kia lou ngal Pathian dang himhim a-omlouhdan i thei uhi."
Van ah leh lei ah pathian min pu tampi om mah le uh, huchibang pathian tampi leh toupate tampi a-om uhi.

Eite a ding in bel Pathian khat kia Pa, a-om a amah kiang a kipan in bangkim apawt a, eite leng amah a dia om i hi uhi. Toupa khat kia, Jesu Khrist a-om hi, amah ziak in bangkim a-om hi, eite leng amah ziak mah a om i hi uhi.

Himahleh huai theihna mi tengteng ah a-om kei hi; khenkhatte milim biakna sa ahih ziak un, milim kiang a kithoihna ahi chih thei napi in tutan in ane uhi; huchi in asia-le-pha theihna uh ahat louh ziak in athanghuaisak uhi.
heading: Unau Hatloute Khualna

paite: Himahleh, sa nek in Pathian mit hon tungsak tuan kei ding a, ne kei mah lehang i se tuan kei a, ne mah lehang leng i hoih tuan sam kei hi.
Himahleh pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw na noplenna uh bangchi chi hiam in mihatloute a ding in pukna ahong hi kha ding hi.
Nang theihna neimi, kuapeuh in milim biakna in a-ankuang um a ahon muh ngal un, amau mihat lou na hita le uh milim kiang a kithoihna thil ne ding in asia-le-pha theihna hong maingal lou ding hia?
Huchi in na theihna ziak in unau hat lou, asih sik a Khrist in asihsakpa, amangthang ding hi.
Unaute tung a huchibang thil na hihkhelh ua, asia-le-pha theihna uh ahat louh nak lai a na liamsak behlap un, Khrist tung ah thil na hihkhial uhi.
Huaiziaktak in ka sa nek in ka unau ahihpuk sang in, ka unau ka hihpuklouhna ding in sa himhim ka ne ngei kei ding hi.
